effective.context:
This is a re-check of the baseline audit 20261122T235204-5620dd, whose two findings no reviewer verified because its review turn produced no verdicts. The purpose is an independent verdict on each of those findings; new findings are welcome but secondary.

Scope of this audit: the advertiser role only. Trace the requirements of the spec's sections 'Advertiser' (under Protocol Roles), 'Advertisers' (Distributing ads across registrars), the definitions 'Advertise Table', 'Bucket' and 'DHT Routing Table' as they bind the advertiser, 'Distance', 'Peer Table Updates', 'Bucket Management', and the advertiser-side rules of 'Error Handling' (ticket handling, retries, waiting). The rest of the spec is staged as reference for definitions and system parameters; do not trace it. Sibling audits cover the registrar, the discoverer, and the messages and signatures.

nim-libp2p is the Nim implementation of libp2p; the Logos service discovery protocol lives in libp2p/protocols/service_discovery.nim (entry module) and libp2p/protocols/service_discovery/. This unit is advertiser.nim (ADVERTISE, the advertise table, ticket retries) and routing_table_manager.nim (the per-service tables and buckets). Other files of the protocol directory (types.nim, connection.nim, dial_backoff.nim, registrar.nim, discoverer.nim) and the Kademlia routing table in libp2p/protocols/kademlia are outside the unit: read them where a requirement leads there, and mark behaviour that lives only there 'not in unit'. Record the resolved commit in the report.

The spec's 'Example ... algorithm' sections, the Appendix and the Implementation Notes are illustrative or recommended; a different algorithm that meets the normative MUST/SHOULD text is not by itself a divergence. Treat code comments that cite the spec as claims to check.

Running tests: tests are Nim unittest files named test_*.nim; tests/test_all.nim imports every test_*.nim under tests/ whose path contains the -d:path substring, so `make test service_discovery` compiles and runs everything under tests/libp2p/service_discovery/ (unit tests there, multi-node tests in component/, shared helpers in utils.nim). The gate puts nim 2.2.14 from /w/cache/nim-2.2.14/bin on PATH and runs `make test service_discovery`. Do not use nix: the flake's dev shell ships a nimble too old for the Makefile. New proof tests go in tests/libp2p/service_discovery/ as their own test_*.nim file named by finding id, are picked up with no other edit, and should copy the header and import style of an existing file there (SPDX header, `{.used.}`, the unittest wrapper from tests/tools/unittest). The build uses --styleCheck:error, so follow the existing naming. No external network is available to tests; a proof that needs a live remote peer is 'needs external evidence'.
